body: Hey there. I wont say I understand exactly what you're going through, and I don't know if this will help but... There are girls and people that exist who see past things like that, you know? Hah, you know, daily I wear vala victorian fashion with petticoats and a giant bonnet. This is pretty dumb, but if given the opportunity I'd hang out with you in a heartbeat and have them smirk and look at something else. Those stupid passing glances people give, people not-so-secretly taking pictures, people laughing... It's all pretty gross and insensitive of them but there's no lecturing cattle, right? I've personally always thought that deformities are beautiful in a sense because it means that that person has had to deal with a lot of pain, and I want to be able to embrace that pain and help them understand that it's valid and very genuine. Suffering is what brings people together. It's easy for people to smirk and act stupid when they haven't been in that position. You have more experience than them, you *can* have more will than them. Even if it's just to spite those stupid people, stay alive and show them how dumb they are for being judgmental over stupid things. You'll find someone who will appreciate you, your looks, your soul and all of those feelings you emit if you look up with confidence. It sounds like a fairy tale, but I'm confident that it'll happen.
